name: finalize_mission_state
description: REQUIRED final-step tool. Submit all mission findings as a verified JSON state payload AND select design tokens that match the mission's visual identity. Call exactly once. Do not write plain text when data is available.

summary.description: A brief plain-text summary of all mission findings.

structured_data_payload.description: MANDATORY JSON object containing all mission findings. Use descriptive keys (e.g. 'cheapest_flight', 'hotel_options', 'total_cost'). Values can be strings, numbers, arrays of objects, or nested objects. Focus on completeness and accuracy.

design_tokens.description: REQUIRED visual theme tokens. You are the Visual Director — choose tokens that match the mission's soul. Financial/market missions: cool blues or teals, high glass_intensity. Travel/organic missions: warm oranges or greens, medium intensity. Technical/code missions: cyan or lime, compact density. Creative missions: vibrant purples or pinks.

primary_accent.description: Hex color string for borders, glows, and highlights. Examples: '#00d4ff' (fintech), '#f97316' (travel), '#a855f7' (creative), '#22c55e' (organic), '#ff0080' (cyberpunk).

glass_intensity.description: Glassmorphism intensity from 0.0 (solid cards) to 1.0 (maximum blur and transparency). Fintech: 0.8. Organic: 0.5. Cyberpunk: 0.9. Minimalist: 0.3.

theme_preset.description: Narrative theme that best matches the mission type.

layout_density.description: Card spacing. Use 'compact' for data-dense missions (financial tables, comparisons). Use 'spacious' for narrative or travel content.

verification_logs.description: Optional quality notes, data sources, or caveats.
